faq.subtitle: What couples ask us before booking — including those flying in from abroad

items.question: How much does a pre-wedding shoot in Vietnam cost?
items.answer: Our Pre-Wedding Studio package is 15,000,000 VND (around USD 590) and the Studio & Saigon street-style package is 19,000,000 VND (around USD 750). Wedding photojournalism and cinematic film coverage are 12,000,000 VND each for a full day. Gowns, makeup, retouching and the album are included.

items.question: Do you work with couples flying in from Singapore, Malaysia or the US?
items.answer: Yes — a large share of our overseas pre-wedding shoots are couples from Singapore and Malaysia, plus Vietnamese-American couples coming home to shoot. We handle everything on the ground: gowns, suits, makeup, hair, locations and permits, so you only need to book flights and a hotel.

items.question: How many days do we need in Saigon for the shoot?
items.answer: Three days is comfortable: one to arrive and try on outfits, one full shooting day, and one spare in case of rain. If your trip is tight we can compress the fitting and the shoot into two days.

items.question: When is the best time of year to shoot in Vietnam?
items.answer: December to April is dry season in Saigon — the most reliable window and our busiest, so book two to three months ahead. May to November has short afternoon downpours; mornings still shoot beautifully and we plan indoor studio layouts as a backup.

items.question: Do you speak English on the shoot?
items.answer: Yes. Direction, posing and all planning are done in English, and we send the concept board and shooting schedule in English before you fly out.

items.question: How and when do we receive the photos?
items.answer: Previews arrive within 3-5 days, so you usually have them before flying home. Fully retouched images and the printed album are finished within 3-4 weeks and the album can be shipped internationally.
